review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Systems Administrator A Big-4-style professional-services firm building its India centre Location: Remote (India) About the Company A Big-4-style professional-services firm is building its India centre and has partnered with Flexiple to hire a systems administrator to run its India IT infrastructure. Role Overview As a Systems Administrator, you will manage servers, directory services, and business-critical systems, balancing uptime with security and compliance requirements. Key Responsibilities
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Role Overview As a Systems Administrator, you will manage servers, directory services, and business-critical systems, balancing uptime with security and compliance requirements. Key Responsibilities Systems Administration Administer Windows/Linux servers, virtualisation, and backup systems Manage Active Directory, identity, and access provisioning Plan and execute patching, upgrades, and capacity changes Security & Compliance Implement and monitor security controls across servers and endpoints Maintain compliance documentation for internal and client audits Own disaster-recovery and backup procedures, and test them regularly Ideal Candidate Profile 3 to 7 years administering enterprise servers and infrastructure Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server and/or Linux administration Working knowledge of Active Directory, virtualisation, and backup/DR practices Clear written and spoken
